old_result.scope: same-host opt-in path projection; independent-host reproduction not claimed

root_cause: The CLI appends env RUSTFLAGS to config.build after constructing action configs; do_cached_build uses config.run.build. The metadata adapter projects paths, but actual kernel compiler argv had no remap, so runtime file! keys stayed real.
support_only_fix: Append or reuse the canonical policy remap in RUSTC_WRAPPER immediately before actual exec; preserve every received OSDK argument. No upstream or kernel source change.
